question: True or false: calling useState after an early return is fine if that return rarely runs.
say: True or false: calling use state after an early return is fine, if that return rarely runs.
explanation: False. When the early return runs, the Hook is skipped, so Hooks are called in a different order. Call every Hook at the top level, before any early return.
explainSay: False. Even a rare early return changes how many Hooks run. Put every Hook at the top, before any return.
